_note: Proxy-routed factory lane (arc-llm-proxy, http://127.0.0.1:8091). Consumers only know arc-proxy/<alias> — never Veles, llama-103, or minimax endpoints directly. Workhorse + lite + driver + bench route through the proxy so the proxy enforces slots, audit logging, and rate/balance tracking. The DEFAULT alias is planner: FastLane primary via arc-proxy/planner (Qwen3.8 on eVeles, no local e103 fallback — pure cloud fast-lane for low-latency interactive work), with claude-afk --model opus --effort low as the direct admin failover when the proxy/Veles is down. Escalation (defense, really difficult): claude-afk opus-medium primary (hard alias), with arc-proxy/minimax-m3 failover. opus-max is forbidden — never use it. Hard aliases (hard, and any defense/escalation alias) follow the same rule: opus-medium primary, arc-proxy/minimax-m3 failover.
